Session: `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`
Branch: none — ⛔ **no file surface**, this is read-only verification. A branch is created only if the run turns up a defect worth a card, and even then the card is filed rather than fixed here.
Worktree: `objectui-issue-5358` (for booting the app only)
Domain: `repo:objectui`
File surface: **none** (stop and report if the run seems to require an edit)
Container & model: M, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`
Clause-②: no — observation only, nothing changes
Serial constraints cleared: **trivially** — a card with no file surface cannot collide with anything. In flight alongside: #5421 (surface TBD), #5398 `plugin-list`, #5365 `packages/components` + `packages/layout`.

Selected as the remaining `pm:blocking` card in the lane's priority order, and picked for this slot precisely *because* it has zero file surface while four code cards are in flight.

⚠️ The one thing that makes or breaks this run: **the console pin must be at or after `7b0783232`** (the #4199 fix). The original QA run (objectstack#7517) executed on `09987b68`, which predates the fix by 42 hours — that is the entire reason this re-test exists. Verify the pin sha **before** interpreting anything the panel does, and record it; a green panel on a pre-fix pin proves nothing, and a red one would re-litigate a settled card.

PIN freshness was separated from BUILD freshness: the console was rebuilt at the pin with pnpm objectui:build, check:console-sha passed, and the running server serves /_console/.objectui-sha = 82a94170c with the served and on-disk index.html naming the same asset bundle. With /api/v1/notifications serving 7 rows (all unread), the header bell panel rendered them under BOTH the Unread and the All sub-filter — no empty state on either tab. Two further legs: after marking 3 rows read the two tabs render different, both non-empty subsets (Unread 1 grouped item, All 4 items), proving the sub-filter filters rather than passing through; and the same holds inside an app, covering both sides of the #4199 isApp question. Evidence comment plus screenshots posted on #4230 (comment 5360081412) with an addendum on pin currency (5360100360). Setup: pnpm install + turbo run build (71/71 tasks, 8m30s) in /home/user/objectstack at b057e53f4, then pnpm objectui:build (console rebuilt at the pin), both under flock -E 99 -w 540 /tmp/os-heavy-verify.lock. Provenance: `pnpm check:console-sha` -> '✓ Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@82a94170c405)'; `curl :3457/_console/.objectui-sha` -> 200 / 82a94170c4058d451ce3ac179d99296d90554479. Ancestry: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 7b0783232 82a94170c` exit=0; reverse exit=1; `... 7b0783232 09987b68` exit=1. Server: objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 3457 -d file:/tmp/os-5358/data.db, health 200. Rows arranged by real delivery (showcase_scheduled_digest on its 60s interval + three showcase_task re-assignments firing task.assigned). Observation driven with Playwright 1.56.1 / Chromium 141 headless at 1440x900; each leg read the API from inside the same browser session and extracted the rendered text of every list item in the popover, plus a literal probe for both empty strings. Leg 1 (console home, off-app): API rows=7 unread=7, Unread tab 4 items, All tab 4 items, empty-state false on both. Leg 2 (same surface, 3 rows marked read via POST /api/v1/notifications/read -> readCount 3): API rows=9 unread=6, Unread tab 1 item, All tab 4 items, empty-state false on both. Leg 3 (in-app, /_console/apps/com.example.showcase): API rows=11 unread=8, Unread tab 1 item, All tab 4 items, empty-state false on both. Six screenshots were read back visually before anything was asserted, per the dogfood skill's visual-truth rule, and are published at https://claude.ai/code/artifact/e0214ec1-cb40-4d2f-a8ca-eb840127bb77 . No ablation applies to this card. Teardown: dev server terminated by PID (14563, found via lsof on port 3457 — never by process name); no background monitors were armed.",

}

**Pointer.** The observation #4230 was waiting for is posted there as [comment 5360081412](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/4230#issuecomment-5360081412), with an addendum on pin currency in [5360100360](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/4230#issuecomment-5360100360). Ruling B's condition is met: the panel renders the rows under both tabs on a post-#4199 pin, so #4230 can now close on evidence rather than on argument — that call is the PM's, not this seat's, so nothing was closed or relabelled here.

**Two things a reader should not over-read from the run.** The panel does not fetch `/api/v1/notifications` when it opens — its rows come from the `AppHeader` poll over `sys_inbox_message` + `sys_notification_receipt`, which is the post-#4199 shape #4225 documents and this card's own caveat predicted. And the boot log's two `SharingServicePlugin` backfill WARNs are objectstack#9237, already fixed on objectstack main by objectstack#9697; the framework checkout used here is 313 commits behind main and simply does not carry it. Searched before filing; nothing filed, so `out_of_scope_findings` is genuinely empty rather than unexamined.
